Hi, I'm Kai-Hong Su, currently pursuing a Master of Business at Monash University, specialising in Data Analytics for Business.

During my studies, I have gained foundational knowledge in machine learning, business forecasting, data visualisation, and economics. Before starting my master's degree, I completed my bachelor's degree in International Tourism Management.

Outside of university, I enjoy playing sports, especially volleyball and badminton. I also like watching movies in my free time.
